mapper.sql: t.id, t.conversation_id, t.turn_id, t.type, t.content, t.is_hidden, t.error_message, t.trace_id, t.agent_key, t.model_provider_key, t.model_name, t.protocol_type, t.feedback_type, t.created_at, t.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM conversation_turn t JOIN conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.turn_id < #{currentTurnId} AND t.is_hidden = 0 AND t.type IN ('user', 'assistant') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn assistant WHERE assistant.conversation_id = t.conversation_id AND assistant.turn_id = t.turn_id AND assistant.type = 'assistant' ) ORDER BY t.turn_id DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM conversation_turn t JOIN conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.turn_id > #{afterTurnId} AND t.turn_id < #{beforeTurnId} AND t.is_hidden = 0 AND t.type IN ('user', 'assistant') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn assistant WHERE assistant.conversation_id = t.conversation_id AND assistant.turn_id = t.turn_id AND assistant.type = 'assistant' ) ORDER BY t.turn_id, t.id

SELECT u.id, u.conversation_id, u.turn_id, u.type, u.content, u.is_hidden, u.error_message, u.trace_id, u.agent_key, u.model_provider_key, u.model_name, u.protocol_type, u.feedback_type, u.created_at, u.updated_at FROM conversation_turn u WHERE u.type = 'user' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn assistant WHERE assistant.conversation_id = u.conversation_id AND assistant.turn_id = u.turn_id AND assistant.type = 'assistant' )

SELECT c.user_id, u.conversation_id, u.turn_id, u.content, u.trace_id FROM conversation_turn u JOIN conversation c ON c.id = u.conversation_id WHERE u.type = 'user' AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM conversation_turn assistant WHERE assistant.conversation_id = u.conversation_id AND assistant.turn_id = u.turn_id AND assistant.type = 'assistant' )

SELECT FROM conversation_turn t JOIN conversation c ON c.id = t.conversation_id WHERE t.conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.is_deleted = 0 AND t.type IN ('user', 'assistant') ORDER BY t.turn_id, t.id
